summary: Radha Blinderman is an Indologist and scholar of religious studies. She has held posts as a Senior Fellow at the Oxford Centre for Hindu Studies (attested 2025) and as a College Fellow at Harvard SAS (attested 2026).

Radha Burnier (1923–2013) was a scholar in Indology and philosophy who studied at Kalakshetra and Banaras Hindu University. She served as Director of the Adyar Library and Research Centre from around 1954 to 1980.

Radha Krishna Choudhary (1921–1985) studied history at Tej Narayan Banaili College and Patna University. An Indology and history scholar, he headed history at Ganesh Dutt College (1946) and taught in the history department at Tilka Manjhi Bhagalpur University (1974–1984).

Radha Kumud Mukherjee (1884–1963) was an Indology and history scholar who studied at the University of Calcutta (~1901–1905). He held posts at Banaras Hindu University (~1916–1917) and Maharaja's College, University of Mysore, heading its history department (~1917–1921).

Radhey Kishori works in computational studies and Indology. Positions held include guest faculty at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University, Agra (2012–2014), Research Fellow at Dr. B. R. Ambedkar University Delhi (2015–2017), and Assistant Professor at IITM (2022–2024).

Radhika Herzberger (born 1938) is an Indology and philosophy scholar. She completed her PhD at the University of Toronto (~1974–1982) under doctoral supervisor Bimal Krishna Matilal, and served as Director of Rishi Valley School from around 1980 to 2005.

Radoslav Katičić (1930–2019) was a linguist and Indologist who studied at the University of Zagreb and under Paul Thieme. He held a post at the University of Vienna (~1977–1998) and was a member of HAZU (~1973–2019).

Rafal Stepien is a scholar of Buddhist studies and philosophy who earned his PhD at Columbia University under Chün-fang Yü and Bernard Faure. He was an Academic Visitor at Wadham College (2012–2013) and an Exchange Scholar at Harvard (attested 2015).

Rafał Felbur is a scholar of Buddhist studies and sinology. He pursued his PhD at Stanford University, with Paul Harrison as his doctoral supervisor, and was taught by John R. McRae and Luis Oscar Gómez.

Rafał Kłeczek is an Indologist, philosopher, and Tibetologist. He held posts at the University of Hyderabad (attested 2016), the Polish Academy of Sciences as an Assistant (attested 2017), and the University of Vienna (attested 2022).
Raffaele Catà is a scholar of philosophy and Indology who completed a laurea at the University of Bologna (2011–2012) under supervisor Manlio Iofrida and co-supervisor Saverio Marchignoli.

Raffaele Pettazzoni (1883–1959) was a scholar of religious studies and history/archaeology who earned degrees at Bologna and Sapienza. He taught the history of religions at the University of Bologna (1914–1922) and Sapienza University of Rome (1923–1958).
Raffaele Torella (born 1950) is an Indologist and philosopher who studied as a disciple under Raniero Gnoli. He has held the Chair of Sanskrit at Sapienza University of Rome (attested 1995–2026).
Raffaello Orlando is a scholar of sinology and Buddhist studies who completed a PhD at Princeton University in 1981 under the supervision of Denis Twitchett.

Raghu Ananthanarayanan is a scholar of philosophy and religious studies who completed postgraduate engineering studies at IIT Madras and studied under Tirumalai Krishnamacharya and T. K. V. Desikachar. He taught at Krishnamacharya Yoga Mandiram and visited IIM Ahmedabad.

Raghu Vira (1902–1963) studied at Punjab, Leiden (D. Litt. under Willem Caland), and under Ralph Lilley Turner. He headed the Sanskrit Department at Sanatan Dharma College (~1932–1946) and directed the International Academy of Indian Culture (from 1934).

Raghunath Damodar Karmarkar (1893–1964) was an Indology and philosophy scholar. He served as Principal of Sir Parashurambhau College and as Director of the Post-Graduate and Research Department at the Bhandarkar Oriental Research Institute.
Raghunath Giri is a scholar of Indology and philosophy who studied under Vamacharana Bhattacharya. He served as a department head at Mahatma Gandhi Kashi Vidyapith.

Rahul Parson is an Indology scholar who earned his PhD at the University of California, Berkeley (2004–2012). He served as Assistant Professor at the University of Colorado Boulder (2016–2020) and UC Berkeley (2021).

Rahul Peter Das (born 1954) studied Indology and linguistics at Cologne and Hamburg under Klaus Ludwig Janert and Albrecht Wezler. He was appointed chair in 1994 and served as Professor der Südasienkunde at Halle-Wittenberg (~1994–2020).
